🎨 Design Alignment & Analytical Methodology

How this standalone application integrates your eRank visual references with Python Selenium scraping & unsupervised ML.

1. eRank Reference Integration (Monthly Trends & Trend Buzz)

Designed directly from your uploaded eRank Monthly Trends and Trend Buzz reference interfaces:

  • Deep Forest Green Navigation Sidebar (#064428): Mirrors eRank's information hierarchy (Dashboard, Phone Case & 🇲🇦 Radar, Keyword Research, Competitor Research, Listing Optimization, Shop Insights, Trends → Trend Buzz & Monthly Trends).
  • Inline 12-Month Trend Graph Sparklines: Every keyword row renders a 12-bar monthly seasonality histogram with highlighted current-month bar and peak search label underneath.
  • Trend Buzz Multi-Metric Columns: Computes Search Interest, Search Trend, Change %, Avg Searches, Avg Clicks, Avg CTR %, Etsy Competition (color-coded bar), and Keyword Difficulty (KD).
  • Global Top Search & Live Scraper Trigger: Filter any table instantaneously or launch a 10-page Python scrape for any new digital product or phone case keyword.
2. Analytical Enhancements Beyond Excel
  • Page 1 to Page 10 Rank Decay Curves: Dynamically compare how unit sales, revenue, review density, and paid ad saturation decay from Page 1 to Page 10 across up to 3 keywords simultaneously.
  • Unsupervised Machine Learning (K-Means + 2D PCA): Standardizes 6 listing features (StandardScaler), optimizes cluster count via Silhouette Score, and projects all 4,000 listings into an interactive 2D Principal Component scatterplot.
  • Interactive Pinterest ROAS & Share-and-Save Simulator: Real-time unit economics modeling that accounts for Etsy's 4% Share & Save fee rebate and calculates maximum profitable CPCs for paid Pinterest traffic.
